title: From A Hobby Project To The Leading AI Game Discovery Platform!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
We started VibeToplist as a hobby project because we couldn't find a decent place to discover quality AI-assisted and vibe-coded games. Never expected it to blow up like this.

We're now approaching 500 game submissions, organic traffic is growing like crazy, and thousands of people are discovering new games through the platform every single day. It's also good to see that the sentiment is slowly starting to change, the mass adoption towards vibe coded games is already on-going, all the trends proof this.

Huge thanks to everyone who's been part of this journey! If you're building an AI-assisted game, you can still list it completely free, and benefit from the platform success.

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)
